scope: Current source/export fidelity, GIF encoding measurements, focused visual repair review, and rendered Godot playback. These observations have different scopes; none is a whole-game quality guarantee.
notes: Eye details in the office worker were repaired with native pixels in the prior unchanged source.
The radar keeps the complete mast and collar fixed; every pose has a natively retouched pitch socket.
Runner motion was rebuilt from a pose guide and refined natively, including shoulder-to-hand ownership through both half-cycles.
All four animals restarted from new generated designs and motion exploration, with selected inputs, rejected studies, and native contact refinements recorded per asset.
GIF encoding uses integer nearest-neighbor magnification. Frame coverage, alpha measurements, and source hashes are separate from visual motion review.

issues.reason: The old rectangular part cut crossed the mast. Alpha connectivity and native file fidelity did not establish a visually continuous joint.
Adjacent running poses changed limb phase and torso view instead of forming a coherent cycle.
The previous animations did not communicate coherent species-appropriate actions.

limits: These are short README animation examples. Transitions between gameplay states and player-controlled motion were not implemented.
Visual observations describe the inspected revisions and do not turn alpha, frame-count, or source-fidelity measurements into an aesthetic score.
